notes.title: Update 1.26
notes.content:
[i]Hello Commanders

We are thrilled to announce a major update in Instant War, packed with exciting new features and improvements that we're sure you'll love. Read more 👇[/i]

[b]🔫 New Offensive Legendary Hero: Valkyrie 
[/b]
- Valkyrie is one of our most powerful Heroes so far. Specialized in Region Gates attacks. The more damage she receives, the more damage she deals. 

[b]⚔️ New Battle Pass Season: Valkyrie (Launched on Friday 7th 2023)
[/b]
- New Battle Pass Season + New Hero Valkyrie (Battle Pass exclusive during Season)
- Battle Pass focuses on Military units
- 90 days Season

[b]⛑️ Unit Healing duration balancing
[/b]
- Units' recovery is reduced by x2 to make battling less punitive at high level.

[b]👇 Flexible Realtime Army Controls (RTS) 
[/b]
- Players can now control their armies in real time: stop and redirect whenever and wherever you want. 
- Camps limit of 8 hours
- March time reduced
- Time to retreat in a battle reduced
- Addition of a 15s fixed duration at the end of a battle (looting time after a win).
- Giant Heroes walking on the World Map replaced by Portraits
- Legacy controls still functional 
- Rework of Main Menu & World Map UI to simplify and speedup the navigation

[b]⭐ Prestige balancing 
[/b]
- Prestige system was balanced to incentivize players into fairer battles

[b]🧱 New construction site?
[/b]
- A secret team of scientists is working on a new technology related to Heroes... Your workers might be already working in your base

[b]🌎 New Segmented World Map 
[/b]
- World Map is now segmented in 3 zones protected by Gates
- Best Resources, Mines and Encounters are located in higher zones (World Map center)
- New mines added in Zone 3 (at the center of the new World Map): Higher Aluminium Mines & New - - Titanium Mines
- When moving your HQ to a higher zone, you gain access to this zone’s assets and lower zone’s ones
- Your Alliance needs to control a Gate for your Units to use it
- Your Alliance needs to control one of the adjacent Regions to capture a Region Gate
- Players from lower zones receive a 75% Recover conversion when attacked by a player from a higher - zone


[i]As always, we rely on your feedback to adjust and continuously improve Instant War. Don’t hesitate to use the appropriate channels! 

Instant War team hopes this update will please you -
Thank you for your support Commanders, see you on the battlefield 🎖️[/i]

notes.title: Update 06/02/2023
notes.content:
[b]Update 06/02/2023
[/b]
[i]Commanders, we’re pleased to announce you multiple changes coming in Instant War from today. Come discover the new Hero Fyra and her set of Events allowing you to summon her (and more). 
[/i]
🔥 [b]New Hero Fyra:[/b] summon the Mistress of Fire and burn your enemies into ashes!
❤️‍🔥[b] New Hero Fragment Event:[/b] Win tokens in Special events to purchase the 100 Fragments necessary to summon Fyra, the news Legendary Hero!
↗️[b] Gameplay update: Stronger Heroes lead stronger Armies! [/b]
      - Improved Heroes (1/2) : The force of a Hero is now added to the Army he leads in battle.
      - Improved Heroes (2/2):  Heroes allow you to command more Units on the battlefield. The stronger the Hero, the more units you can command!
⚙️ [b]Several bug fixes and improvement[/b]



 [i]As always we’ll welcome your feedback and opinions about these. See you on the battlefield Commanders! [/i]
